error.message:
Expected upstream_failure: R odbc loses integer Date classes or difftime units, and timestamp binding does not match its own quoted timestamp literal. Reference: https://github.com/r-dbi/odbc/blob/v1.4.2/src/odbc_result.cpp. Reproducer: repros/r-bind-types.R.
Reported FAILED: `rows` (`actual`) not equal to `result` (`expected`).

actual vs expected
                  a   b   c
- actual[1, ]   2.5 2.5 2.5
+ expected[1, ] 1.5 1.5 1.5

actual$a != expected$a but don't know how to show the difference

actual$b != expected$b but don't know how to show the difference

actual$c != expected$c but don't know how to show the difference
